answer:
H2G-7165 changes where the AI Data admin screen gets its data. It now reads the extraction response of a processed worksheet from the Kafka extract topics instead of Redis [S1]. Redis no longer holds AI extraction responses [S1].

Other details for developers:
- Opening a detail is one search and one single-message read. The list is one paged search, and its cost does not grow with stored responses [S2].
- The API logs list and detail with package tracking id, worksheet, topic, partition, offset and result (found, expired, unavailable), prefixed `[AIData]` [S3].
- The payload holds employee data and is never logged [S3].
- To verify after deploy, process an Unstructured file, open its worksheets, and confirm no `ai_response_` keys are created in Redis [S3].
